messages:
tanya: FYI escalated from AcmeCorp — customer reports invoice shows ~12k tokens more than the dashboard for Mar 3. They say this happened during a brief connectivity issue.

james: Can you paste the customer's sample request IDs + idempotency keys?

tanya: From ticket: "req=acct_2234; idempotency=abc123..." — they attached ingress logs. snippet:
```
[ingress] 2026-03-03T14:02:11Z conn_reset req=acct_2234 idempotency=abc12345 body_len=1352
[ingress] 2026-03-03T14:02:12Z retry_spawn req=acct_2234 idempotency=abc12345_1 body_len=1352
```

ryan-sdk: That idempotency key looks mutated by our SDK on reconnect — suffixing _1 when it thinks prior attempt failed. Known behaviour if socket resets mid-stream.

tanya: Customer says SDK 0.9.1. Does our backend dedupe rely on exact idempotency key match? If mutated it's treated as new request.

kevin-billing: Correct — ledger increments per accepted request. If client resends with different idempotency key, it will bill twice. We can credit if we verify double execution.

james: Repro plan: emulate conn reset mid-request with SDK 0.9.1, observe outgoing idempotency header. I'll run quick test and attach logs.

james: (after test) Repro'd — SDK reconnect logic appends suffix when it detects partial send. Commands used:
```
python repro_conn_flap.py --sdk-version 0.9.1 --payload-size 1.3k
```
Logs:
```
CLIENT -> SERVER: POST /v1/outputs idempotency: abc123
TCP RST
CLIENT -> SERVER: POST /v1/outputs idempotency: abc123_1
SERVER: 200 OK (first attempt made it through)
```

ryan-sdk: Oof. So backend accepted both because header differed. We should consider normalizing idempotency keys server-side for short suffix patterns or prefer server-side request fingerprinting for exact-body-dedup.

tanya: Customer asked for immediate remediation and a credit. Kevin, can we do a targeted credit for acct_2234 on Mar 3?

kevin-billing: I'll open a billing adjustment. Need list of invoice lines and request_ids. Tanya, please attach ledger rows (we can query by customer id + day).

tanya: Attached ledger extract and example request_ids: r_01A, r_01B show same payload hash but different idempotency headers. Also dashboard shows tokens 120k, invoice 132k.

kevin-billing: Prelim credit approved for delta 12k tokens pending audit. Also logging follow-up: create an SRE ticket to add a dedupe pass that compares payload hash + client-id within 30s window.

james: I'll file eng-ticket: dedupe-by-fingerprint, and add a metric for 'possible-replayed-requests' when identical payload-hash with different idempotency in short window.

ryan-sdk: We'll patch SDK behaviour too — avoid mutating idempotency, instead reuse same key and escalate reporting. ETA patch v0.9.2.

tanya: Sending customer update: credit pending, root cause likely SDK resend on conn reset. Asking them to upgrade. :thumbsup: 
ingress-bot: deploy queued for dedupe patch branch #348

tanya: closing loop — will post final once credit applied.
